{{short description|Peruvian chemist, author and politician}}
{{family name hatnote|Zevallos|Bueno|lang=Spanish}}
'''Rafael Jerko Zevallos Bueno''' (born 4 April 1973) is a Peruvian chemist, author, and politician. He holds a chemistry degree from the [[National University of San Marcos]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.politico.pe/staff/rafael-zevallos/|title=Rafael Zevallos|first=Columnas de Opinión|last=Politico.PE|website=politico.pe}}</ref>

A member of the [[Peruvian Aprista Party]] since 1998 and of its [[National Executive Committee of the Peruvian Aprista Party|National Executive Committee]] from 2010 to 2017,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.radionacional.com.pe/noticias/dialogo-abierto/rafael-zevallos-con-la-muerte-de-alan-garcia-se-cierra-un-ciclo-y-se-abre-otro|title=Rafael Zevallos: "Con la muerte de Alan García se cierra un ciclo y se abre otro"|first=Radio|last=Nacional|website=radionacional.com.pe}}</ref> Zevallos announced his candidacy for [[President of Peru]] in the [[2021 Peruvian general election]] in September 2020. In the primary election held on 29 November 2020, he faced former [[Ministry of Women and Vulnerable Populations|Minister of Women and Social Development]], [[Nidia Vílchez]], and former congressional nominee, [[Juan Carlos Sánchez Montes de Oca]], for the APRA presidential nomination.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://elcomercio.pe/politica/elecciones/eleciones-2021-nidia-vilchez-anuncia-su-precandidatura-presidencial-en-el-partido-aprista-noticia/|title=Elecciones 2021: Nidia Vílchez competirá en las internas del Apra por la candidatura presidencial|first=Diario|last=El Comercio|website=elcomercio.pe}}</ref> He eventually placed third with 745 votes at national level.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://elcomercio.pe/politica/apra-nidia-vilchez-encabeza-resultados-de-elecciones-internas-al-606-de-actas-contabilizadas-elecciones-2021-nndc-noticia/|title=APRA: Nidia Vílchez encabeza resultados de elecciones internas al 60,6% de actas contabilizadas|first=Diario|last=El Comercio|website=elcomercio.pe}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Elecciones 2021 &#124; Partido Aprista Peruano ONPE|language=es}}</ref>

Zevallos is the author of ''From anti-imperialism to post-capitalism and the APRA'', published by the Editorial Fund of the [[National University of San Marcos]], in February 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://unmsm.edu.pe/noticias/ver/fondo-editorial-de-la-unmsm-publica-libros-sobre-el-apra-y-las-practicas-comunicativas|title=Fondo Editorial de la UNMSM publica libros sobre el APRA y las prácticas comunicativas|first=Noticias|last=Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos|website=unmsm.edu.pe}}</ref> He is also the brother of [[Marco Antonio Zevallos]], a ranking member of [[First The People – Community, Ecology, Liberty, and Progress]] and a former member of the [[Purple Party]].
